source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    full_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    if full_rows:
        axis, marker = 'row', full_rows[0]
    else:
        axis, marker = 'col', full_cols[0]
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != bg and not (r == marker if axis == 'row' else c == marker)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c, _ in cells:
        out[r][c] = bg
    if axis == 'row':
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c, v in cells), max(r for r, c, v in cells)
        delta = marker + 1 - lo if lo > marker else marker - 1 - hi
        moved = [(r + delta, c, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        far = max(r for r, c, v in moved) if moved[0][0] > marker else min(r for r, c, v in moved)
        line = far + 1 if far > marker else far - 1
        out[line] = [8] * w
    else:
        lo, hi = min(c for r, c, v in cells), max(c for r, c, v in cells)
        delta = marker + 1 - lo if lo > marker else marker - 1 - hi
        moved = [(r, c + delta, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        far = max(c for r, c, v in moved) if moved[0][1] > marker else min(c for r, c, v in moved)
        line = far + 1 if far > marker else far - 1
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][line] = 8
    return out
'''
